short_description: VMware ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability (CVE-2026-41709, CVSS 2.7): a malicious administrator can perform certain operations without them being logged, letting an intruder who has reached admin level hide activity; fixed in ESXi-9.1.0.0-25370933, ESXi-9.0.2.0100-25595025 and ESXi80U3j-25429389 per the VMSA-2026-0006.2 response matrix.
title: VMware ESX insufficient logging (CVE-2026-41709)
